svg.aria-label: A shrink in six steps. Check reads only. Clean removes only what you chose. Stop stops the containers with their own timeouts and runs the pre-stop scripts. Compact is WSL's own wsl --manage --compact. Verify reads the disk again, block by block. Start again brings the distribution and its containers back.
